<style>
  .sm-filter { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; margin: 0 auto 24px; max-width: 760px; }
  .sm-search { position: relative; }
  .sm-search i { position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: #8b96b8; }
  .sm-search input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px 12px 44px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 1rem;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); color: #e8ecf7; outline: none; }
  .sm-search input:focus { border-color: #00e5ff; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,229,255,0.25); }
  .sm-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; }
  .sm-chip { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: #c5cee8;
    border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 14px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
  .sm-chip:hover { border-color: #00e5ff; }
  .sm-chip.on { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a855f7, #ff2fb4); border-color: transparent; color: #fff; }
  .sm-filter-count { text-align: center; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #8b96b8; min-height: 1.2em; }
  .sm-card[hidden] { display: none !important; }
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  var cards = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#game-grid .sm-card'));
  var input = document.getElementById('game-search'), chipsEl = document.getElementById('game-chips'),
      countEl = document.getElementById('game-count'), active = 'all';
  var tags = {};
  cards.forEach(function (c) { c.dataset.tags.split(' ').forEach(function (t) { tags[t] = (tags[t] || 0) + 1; }); });
  var names = Object.keys(tags).filter(function (t) { return tags[t] > 1; }).sort();
  [['all', 'All']].concat(names.map(function (t) { return [t, t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1)]; })).forEach(function (p) {
    var b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'sm-chip' + (p[0] === 'all' ? ' on' : '');
    b.dataset.tag = p[0]; b.textContent = p[1] + (p[0] === 'all' ? '' : ' (' + tags[p[0]] + ')'); chipsEl.appendChild(b);
  });
  function apply() {
    var q = input.value.trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean), shown = 0;
    cards.forEach(function (c) {
      var hay = (c.textContent + ' ' + c.dataset.tags).toLowerCase();
      var ok = (active === 'all' || c.dataset.tags.split(' ').indexOf(active) >= 0) && q.every(function (w) { return hay.indexOf(w) >= 0; });
      c.hidden = !ok; if (ok) shown++;
    });
    countEl.textContent = shown === cards.length ? cards.length + ' games' :
      shown ? shown + ' of ' + cards.length + ' games' : 'No games match \u2014 try another word or clear the filter.';
  }
  chipsEl.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest('.sm-chip'); if (!b) return;
    active = b.dataset.tag; [].forEach.call(chipsEl.children, function (x) { x.classList.toggle('on', x === b); }); apply();
  });
  input.addEventListener('input', apply);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === '/' && document.activeElement !== input && !/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(document.activeElement.tagName)) { e.preventDefault(); input.focus(); }
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && document.activeElement === input) { input.value = ''; apply(); input.blur(); }
  });
  apply();
})();
</script>
